items.reason: Gap 0 describes overlapping duplicate deliveries both passing the processed-ID check before either records the ID and both running the handler.
Gap 2 states that the deduplication key comes from the unsigned X-Event-Id header and can be changed on a replayed signed body to bypass deduplication.
Gap 3 identifies that the provider sends charge.refunded while only refund.created is registered, causing real refunds to remain unhandled.
No gap alleges a failure caused by unshared state across multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
